content: The webhook retry logic stops after the first 5xx response. Our endpoint returned 503 during a deploy window and the delivery log shows a single attempt with no backoff. Expected up to five retries per the documentation.

Refund amounts round down on multi-currency invoices. A 24.99 EUR line item refunds as 24.00 EUR, which looks like integer truncation somewhere in the FX conversion path. Only reproducible with non-USD currencies.

Session expires while an agent is drafting a reply. Drafts longer than fifteen minutes are lost on submit, so agents end up re-typing responses several times a day. Please extend the session or autosave drafts.
The dashboard chart tooltips overflow their container on narrow screens. Everything else renders correctly; this is purely a layout issue below about 480px wide.
Sorting the transactions table by date treats null timestamps as the epoch, so pending rows jump to the top. They should sort last, or be grouped separately.
CSV export uses commas inside unquoted description fields, which breaks import into the finance tool. Wrapping the fields in quotes should fix it.
Dark mode contrast fails WCAG AA on the secondary buttons. The foreground grey on the dark background measures about 3.1:1; we need at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
Copy-to-clipboard silently fails on Firefox when the page is served over plain HTTP. No error is surfaced to the user, so they think the copy worked. Works fine over HTTPS.
The date picker allows selecting February 30th and then throws a 500 on submit. Client-side validation should reject impossible dates before the request is sent.
Infinite scroll re-fetches page one whenever the window is resized, wasting bandwidth and briefly showing duplicate rows. The scroll position should be preserved across resize events.
Uploading a zero-byte file shows a success toast even though nothing is stored. The upload endpoint should reject empty files with a clear validation message.
Long issue titles are not truncated in the list view and push the timestamp column off screen. Titles over roughly eighty characters should be ellipsised.
The retry banner flickers on slow connections because it mounts and unmounts on every poll. Debouncing the visibility by a second or two would smooth it out.
Search returns stale results for a few seconds after a record is deleted. Looks like a cache invalidation gap between the write path and the search index.
Autofocus jumps to the wrong field when tabbing through the new-ticket form, which is disorienting for keyboard users. The focus order should follow the visual layout.
Empty states render a broken image icon instead of the placeholder illustration. The placeholder asset returns a 404, so it was probably missed in the last asset migration.
The timezone label shows UTC even when the user's profile is set to Pacific time. The times themselves are converted correctly; only the label is wrong.
Pagination cursor is off by one on the final page, so the last record of each result set is occasionally skipped in the export. Minor but it confuses reconciliation.
Table headers do not stick on scroll in the reports view, so once you scroll past the first screen you lose track of which column is which. A sticky header would help a lot.
The modal traps keyboard focus incorrectly for screen readers: focus escapes to the page behind it, so users can tab into hidden controls. The dialog needs a proper focus trap.
Customer reports that the refund confirmation email arrives twice. Looks like the notification worker processes the same job on retry without an idempotency key. Duplicate suppression would fix it.
The API returns 200 with an empty body when a transaction is not found, instead of a 404. Clients cannot distinguish 'no result' from 'success with no data'. Please return a proper status code.
Rate limiting kicks in too aggressively for the reporting endpoint during month-end, when legitimate batch jobs run. Consider a higher limit or a separate bucket for service accounts.
The onboarding checklist does not persist across page reloads, so users who refresh mid-setup start over. The completed steps should be stored server-side against the account.
Webhook signatures use an old hashing scheme that a couple of partners have deprecated. We should add support for the newer signature header while keeping the old one for backward compatibility.
Transaction txn_3ab21f9c succeeded on 14 August 2026. The amount was 49.99 USD and the customer of record is dana@northwind.example. No further action is required.
Transaction txn_7de40b12 is still pending as of 2 September 2026. The amount is 1299.00 USD for ops@fabrikam.example; it should settle within two business days.
Transaction txn_91cc02ef was refunded on 28 July 2026. The refunded amount is 25.00 EUR to lee@contoso.example. The refund reference matches the original charge.
Created issue number 900 in acme/support-portal. The issue titled 'Duplicate refund email' is now open and can be viewed at the returned URL. It was filed by the support automation account.
Created issue number 901 in acme/billing-api. The retry-backoff tracking issue is open and assigned for triage. The URL points to the newly created issue.
Feature request: allow bulk closing of resolved tickets from the list view. Right now each ticket has to be closed individually, which is slow when clearing a backlog after an incident.
The exported PDF invoice is missing the tax breakdown line when the tax rate is zero. It should still show a 0.00 line for clarity rather than omitting the row entirely.

Two customers on the same account see each other's draft replies for a moment during a race between the autosave and the fetch. It clears on refresh but it is unsettling. Probably a cache key that omits the user id.
The mobile app shows the wrong relative time ('in 2 hours' for a past event) after the device wakes from sleep, because the cached clock offset is stale. Recomputing on resume should fix it.
Please add a keyboard shortcut to jump to the next unresolved ticket. Agents handling a queue would save a lot of mouse travel. Something like 'j' and 'k' to move between items would be ideal.
The status filter and the date filter do not combine correctly: selecting both returns the union instead of the intersection. Users expect filters to narrow results, not widen them.
Attachments over 10 MB fail with a generic error. If there is a size limit it should be stated up front and enforced client-side, rather than failing after a long upload.
The weekly summary email lands in spam for a couple of domains. Adding a proper DKIM signature and a plain-text alternative part should improve deliverability.
When two agents open the same ticket, whoever saves last silently overwrites the other's notes. A simple 'this ticket changed since you opened it' warning would prevent lost work.
The graph on the metrics page shows gaps where data is simply zero, making it look like an outage. Zero values should render as a point on the line rather than a break.
Localization: the German translation for 'refund' is missing, so that button falls back to English. A quick pass over the missing keys in the de locale would clean it up.
The health check endpoint returns 200 even when the database connection pool is exhausted. It should verify a real query so load balancers can route around an unhealthy instance.
Customers on annual plans are shown a monthly price in the upgrade dialog. The number is correct per month but the cadence label is wrong, which causes confused support tickets.
The audit log view is very slow to load for accounts with a long history because it fetches everything at once. Paginating the log or lazy-loading older entries would help a lot.
A tooltip explaining what 'pending' means on the payment status badge would reduce confusion. Several customers have asked whether pending means failed. A one-line explanation on hover is enough.
The payment for order 4821 completed normally. Funds were captured, the receipt was sent, and the ledger entry reconciles with the daily settlement report. Nothing outstanding on this order.
Please document the webhook retry schedule in the developer docs. Partners keep asking how many retries to expect and over what window. A short table would answer most of the questions we get.
The 'export to CSV' button is disabled with no explanation when a filter returns no rows. A tooltip saying 'nothing to export' would be clearer than a greyed-out button.
Line breaks in customer messages are collapsed when shown in the agent view, so formatted messages become one long paragraph. Preserving newlines would make longer messages readable.
The settings page saves silently with no confirmation, so users are unsure whether their change took effect. A brief 'saved' indicator next to the field would reassure them.
